titleTh: หมวด 6 — การจัดซื้อและจัดจ้าง (Canonical Data Contracts)
note: Static-only canonical data contracts for Category 6 (การจัดซื้อและจัดจ้าง / Procurement), modeling the frozen FY2568 historical baseline for FY2569 reuse. All 6 indicators (6.1.1-6.2.3) resolve to dedicated evidence anchored on the SHA-verified fy2568-publication.json cat6 manifest (32/32 source-mirror-manifest match). FY2568 is the baseline layer for FY2569: recurring evidence (eco-procurement %, product-list review, policy briefing, monthly contractor evaluations) is labeled awaiting-update and must be re-collected in FY2569 — never relabeled. The FY2569-budget cleaning contract (สัญญาจ้างทำความสะอาด 69.pdf) is QUARANTINED (candidateFy2569Only) and never a sourceRef/evidence. Two evaluation-form pairs are contentDuplicateCandidate (each path keeps its own sourceRef — no dedup). No scores, no PASS claims, no FY2569 facts.

contracts.note: Eco product procurement: responsible persons, search sources, Form 6.1(1) product list, Form 6.1(2) procurement report (source-declared %), material survey.

Guideline for selecting eco external services (hotel search sources, examples, Form 6.2(3)); no external eco service used in FY2568 (declared).
